api: GET https://jihs.ut.ac.ir/?_action=article&keywords=<q> (the journal site's own search form, server-rendered results list; each hit carries title, authors, DOI and — once published — a direct PDF link); full text: the hit's own PDF file https://jihs.ut.ac.ir/article_<id>_<hash>.pdf, linked from the results page (class="pdf_link") and from the article page
name: تاریخ علم — Journal for the History of Science (JIHS), Institute for the History of Science, University of Tehran
notes: LIVE-WIRED §36 (probe 2026-11-26): the direct site of مجلهٔ تاریخ علم, the journal of the Institute for the History of Science, University of Tehran (پژوهشکدهٔ تاریخ علم دانشگاه تهران) — Iran's first and only specialised history-of-science journal, علمی-پژوهشی, Persian with English abstracts, open access (CC BY 4.0). It was already reachable indirectly via the §34 Ensani route; this direct route removes the Ensani lag so the newest issues arrive as soon as the journal publishes them. Routes tried: (1) the site's own search form — the homepage form (GET ./, hidden _action=article, text field keywords) resolves to GET /?_action=article&keywords=<q> and ANSWERS with real records, no login and no token needed (بیرونی -> 21 results; تاریخ علم -> 167 results, 25 per page). Each results block carries the article title, authors, the issue line (دوره/شماره), a DOI (10.22059/jihs...) and, for published articles, a direct PDF link (class="pdf_link"). (2) Full text via that direct PDF link — probe-verified WITHOUT login or cookies: article_106822_....pdf -> HTTP 200, application/pdf, 288,122 B, %PDF-1.5 (the size badge on the page, 281.37 K, matches). Candidates therefore carry oa_pdf_url = the article's own PDF file, and attach_fulltexts_v2 fetches the PDF directly. (3) Online-first articles (مقالات آماده انتشار) have NO PDF yet — neither in the results list nor on their article pages (article_108572.html checked: no PDF link) — so the parser emits only hits that carry a PDF link, per the full-text-only law. (4) Issue/archive listing pages (issue_<id>_<id>.html, e.g. issue_13738_13913.html -> 200) list each issue's articles — covered by the site search, not queried separately. (5) sitemap.xml exists (200, ~73 KB, lists /browse and article URLs) and robots.txt is permissive and points to it — neither is needed, the search route suffices. (6) RSS: /rss.xml -> 404, /rss.php -> 404, /journal/rss -> 404, /?_action=rss -> 403 — no usable feed. (7) Alternate hosts: www.jihs.ut.ac.ir did not answer from the sandbox (connection failed); http://jihs.ut.ac.ir returned an empty reply — the canonical https://jihs.ut.ac.ir host is the wired one. (8) Index fallbacks (Crossref/DOAJ -> the journal's DOIs) not needed: the journal's own routes passed both bars.
